selectionMethod: Sum 2021 Census population counts from Statistics Canada table 98-10-0004-01 for the lower-tier members listed in Ontario municipal registry (validated June 2026). Use only Lower Tier rows; all Single Tier rows are excluded even when their geographic area names match a county. Census-division totals and designated places are never added. 2021 boundaries/counts used consistently; registry membership is current and matched by normalized CSD name, with one explicit bilingual alias for The Nation / La Nation.
scope: Roads only. D=detailed published procedure; H=sourced general/responsibility handoff; H?=partial responsibility handoff; G=explicit unresolved gap. All integrations research_only.
